root_cause: Production ClaudeStructuredClient.generate() sends temperature=0 on every messages.parse request (hard-coded in app/services/claude_client.py). claude-opus-5 rejects any request that includes the temperature parameter. The fixed production matcher contract therefore cannot be sent to claude-opus-5 without modifying production code.
action_taken: STOPPED. No silent fix. No retry. No production code change. No manual rerun. Opus 5 excluded from Round 1 results.
raw_predictions_file: benchmark_round1_predictions_opus-5.json (contains 30 rejected-call records, no model output)
future_inclusion_note: To benchmark claude-opus-5 later, an eval-only client variant that omits temperature for models that require it would be needed. That changes the API request shape, so it is a TRANSPORT-level difference from the Sonnet baseline / Haiku run and would require its own re-baseline before any cross-model claim. Not built here.
